actual_evidence: 160°C reaction temperature and ChCl/GA/H2O (1:3:6) DES were used in all reactions. When HMF/furfural was used as a feedstock, reaction time was limited to 2 minutes, otherwise, it was set at 10 minutes. MIBK was used as extracting solvent unless otherwise stated. ｜ Table 1 ... 4 ZnCl2 as catalyst, glucose/xylose as feedstock 10 51
explanation: 两项必需事实齐备：DES 组成为 ChCl/GA/H2O (1:3:6) 且写明『used in all reactions』；微波条件为 160 ℃、10 min（非 HMF/糠醛原料时统一 10 min，即糖混合物条件）。『不外加催化剂』由 Table 1 的实验设计可确认——全部条目中只有 entry 4 单独标注『ZnCl2 as catalyst』，其余（含 entry 3 glucose/xylose as feedstock）均为无外加催化剂基线。块来源即指定论文 → 3，维持原判。
review_basis: 原题+必需事实+硬性来源限定+完整原块阅读

actual_evidence: the Pt1/ Nb2O5-Ov cooperated very well to promote the selective hydrogenation of HMF to MF. The Pt atom was responsible for the activation of H2 and the Nb sites activated C–OH. ｜ Both Pd1/Nb2O5-Ov and Au1/Nb2O5-Ov showed >99% selectivity of MF
explanation: 必需事实 2 逐字命中（Pt 活化 H2、Nb 活化 C–OH）；必需事实 3 只到『SAC 的 MF 选择性 >99%』这一半，块内未出现『at complete conversion』的条件限定；必需事实 1（C=O 加氢在动力学与热力学上优于 C–OH）在本块完全不出现。3 项命中 1 完整 + 1 部分 → 2。旧判 3 过高。
review_basis: 原题+必需事实+硬性来源限定+完整原块阅读

actual_evidence: Pt1/Nb2O5-Ov could efficiently catalyze the selective hydrogenation of HMF to MF with >99% selectivity at complete conversion of HMF in 4 h. The turnover frequency of producing MF could reach 1875 h−1 ｜ The quantum chemical calculations demonstrated that HMF could be hydrogenated to produce MF and DMF with Gibbs free energy (ΔG) of −1.37 and −2.93 eV
explanation: 必需事实 3 完整命中（>99% 选择性、complete conversion、4 h）。必需事实 2（Pt/Nb 分工）在本块不出现；必需事实 1（C=O 与 C–OH 的动力学/热力学比较）也不出现——块内 ΔG 计算针对的是 HMF→MF 与 HMF→DMF，而非 C=O 与 C–OH 之争。3 项命中 1 项 → 2。旧判 3 过高。
review_basis: 原题+必需事实+硬性来源限定+完整原块阅读
